originalGenerationPrompt:
Extract and redesign the cannon artwork from the approved pirate-village reference into ONE production sprite-sheet PNG with a fully transparent background. This is game artwork, not a UI screenshot. Preserve the reference's richly shaded stylized 3D miniature look: rounded dark iron barrels, warm timber, brass bands, beveled stone plinths, subtle soft contact shadows, soft neutral upper-left daylight, clean small readable silhouettes. No flat vector shapes or thick black cartoon outlines. No scenery, text, numbers, labels, borders, watermarks, checkerboard, colored backdrop or UI.

EXACT SHEET ORGANIZATION: landscape1536×1024 requested. An invisible regular grid of FIVE columns and FOUR rows,20 separate sprites total. Every cell has the same width and height. Keep each object's complete opaque body and soft shadow safely inside its own cell with generous transparent gutters on ALL sides. No sprite touches a cell border, no object crosses between cells. Same camera three-quarter front view for all cells. Barrel aims toward upper-right, matching a right-facing game's default. All20 objects have their ground-foot centered horizontally and at EXACTLY84% of their cell's height; keep identical grounding across a level's states. Leave clear transparent margin beneath and above. Fit the full sprite and muzzle flash inside the cell. Keep the cannon base wide and grounded.

FIVE COLUMNS left to right are levels1,2,3,4,5:
1: small iron cannon on a carved warm wood carriage, modest brass fittings.
2: reinforced cannon, extra brass rings and a simple beveled stone pad.
3: substantial dark iron cannon, ornate brass trunnions, strong octagonal gray-stone foundation.
4: taller reinforced cannon with blue accents and gold trim, substantial stone foundation.
5: strongest cannon with restrained gilded bands and naval-blue/gold details, elaborate foundation; still clearly a cannon.

FOUR ROWS top to bottom are ACTUAL STATES of the SAME five level designs:
ROW1: intact idle, no flash/smoke.
ROW2: firing, same body and base/ground foot but a short believable recoil and compact golden muzzle flash with a wisp of smoke, all contained inside its cell.
ROW3: damaged but standing: obvious cracks in the base, dents/chips, a darkened damaged barrel and restrained smoke; preserve each level's identity.
ROW4: destroyed and unable to fire: low scattered foundation rubble, broken carriage, shattered iron barrel lying on its side, level-specific debris/gold pieces. No upright healthy cannon and no flash.

Every row must contain EXACTLY5 evenly spaced distinct sprites. Make the result a coherent polished game-ready20-frame sheet, transparent around and between objects, using the same material richness as the attached reference.

spacingRequest:
This is a production transparent CANNON SPRITE SHEET. Preserve the exact beautiful original cannon designs, material richness, five level progression and four states from this sheet. Make a LAYOUT/SPACING correction so every sprite can be cropped into its own complete game frame.

Canvas1536×1024 with exactly5equal columns×4equal rows (eachcolumn about307px wide, eachrow256px high). Keep same ordering:
Row1: intact cannons levels1,2,3,4,5.
Row2: firing cannons levels1,2,3,4,5.
Row3: damaged cannons levels1,2,3,4,5.
Row4: broken/rubble cannons levels1,2,3,4,5.

Each sprite, including ALL loose rubble, muzzle flash, smoke and its small soft contact shadow, must fit entirely inside its own cell with at least16 clear transparent pixels at every cell edge. Recenter each sprite and shrink its entire silhouette slightly as necessary to create clear empty gutters. Especially separate the firing level5 base from the damaged level5 smoke below it. Do not put any rubble or smoke across a row or column boundary.

Use the same ground-baseline position at localy228 of EVERYcell, and center each cannon's ground foundation at localx153. The complete main body, smoke and debris must sit above/beside that baseline and clear all edges. Keep same orientation: barrel faces upper-right. Keep all five level designs distinctly readable, with wood/lightiron atlevel1, stone bases and increasing brass/naval decoration later, level5heavygoldtrim. Firing has restrained muzzleflash/recoil, damaged has genuinely cracked bases and battered metal, broken has a collapsed disconnected wreck. No healthy cannon in broken row.

Retain genuine transparent alpha. Outside the twenty distinct objects and their restrained local contact shadows use alpha exactly0, including gutters and all canvas corners; no color field, blurred background glow, checkerboard, opaque matte, scenery, floor tile, grid lines, labels or text. This is a careful sprite layout edit, not a new concept scene. Deliver one clean transparent production PNG.
acceptedCleanupRequest:
Clean the transparency of this original twenty-frame cannon sprite sheet for game use. Keep EXACTLY the same1536×1024 canvas, twenty cannon bodies, five level designs, four state rows, positions, dimensions, materials, barrel directions, bases, gold trim and rubble. Do not rescale or rearrange any cannon body.

Remove ALL the colored/gray blurred background glow and haze. All empty regions between the actual objects must be genuinely transparent alpha0. Remove the floating GRAY SMOKE wisps from the firing and damaged frames entirely; keep only the actual bright fire/muzzle flashes in the firing row. The game has its own smoke effects. Keep damaged cannons' broken rims/cracked bases and all broken-row rubble. Keep only restrained tight contact shadows directly below the supports, confined within a few pixels of each cannon's base.

There must be clear transparent separation between every frame, particularly between row2's level5 base and row3's damaged level5 cannon. The resulting gutters should not contain gray fog, colored glows or almost-opaque background. All four canvas corners alpha0. Maintain soft clean anti-aliasing only around actual edges of metal/wood/stone, flashes and local shadows. No background color field, checkerboard, labels, borders, floor plane, scene or new object. Output one authentic transparent RGBA PNG.
notes: The accepted export is copied byte-for-byte into public/village/cannons-v1.png. No offline pixel edits or crop were performed. Floating baked gray smoke was removed while muzzle flashes, material/state damage and all rubble remain; the game retains its own smoke effects. Explicit rects and virtual fitBounds describe source pixels without clipping neighboring poses. Source art and mock-canvas probes are not actual game screenshots.
